title: 한국해양소년단연맹 육성에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Orders to Suspend Profit-Making Projects)
(1) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries finds that a supporting organization conducting a profit-making project under Article 6 uses or is likely to use profits from the project for purposes other than the operation of the Association, the Minister may order the supporting organization to suspend the project for a specified period not exceeding six months and take necessary measures.
(2) Detailed criteria for project suspension under paragraph (1) and other necessary matters shall be prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries.
